                                                 ORDER


           This matter comes before the Court on pro se Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentinc’s Motion for

  Partial Summary Judgment.       Dkt. 6.   On August 6. 2026, Plaintiff filed both her Amended

  Complaint and her Motion for Partial Summary Judgment. Dkts. 5. 6. Moreover. Defendants’

  answers or other responses to the Original Complaint are not due until August 21. 2026. Dkts. 3,

  4. Accordingly. Plaintiff s Motion for Partial Summary Judgment is premature. See, e.g.,Champy

  V.   Beazer Homes Carp., 2016 WL 6525484, at *2 (D.S.C. Nov. 2, 2016) (recognizing summary

 judgment was premature).

           Accordingly, it is hereby ORDERED that Plaintiffs Motion (Dkt. 6) is DENIED without

  prejudice to renewal at an appropriate time.

           IT IS SO ORDERED. The Clerk’s Office is directed to provide a copy to pro se Plaintiff

  at her last known address.
